lines.speaker: lise
lines.text: A spear on the bridge, an archer on the rise past it. The ford's further east.

lines.speaker: mc
lines.text: We don't have to beat them. We have to get past them.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Get {mc} to the north road, where it leaves the forest. The others can follow.

lines.speaker: hask
lines.text: Mind the ford. It's slow going, and anyone standing in it is easy to hit.
